rule: R54 entity list (R54_entities.csv: 220 entities, 34 merged territories). Every Natural Earth feature belongs to the R54 entity of its code (ADM0_A3, through ne_codes where NE's code is not R54's); a merged territory goes to its host as R54 lists it; a de-facto entity with no base data starts as part of the host with a defacto flag (R54 Part 2, rule T), so it is no field entity; a feature R54 does not name goes to the state that administers it (leftover, Eくん's reading of actual administration, T); the unadministered scraps are no entity.
